title: GlossaryTerm
description: This schema defines te Glossary term entities.

name.description: Name that identifies the source of an external glossary term. Example `HealthCare.gov`.

endpoint.description: Name that identifies the source of an external glossary term. Example `HealthCare.gov`.

conceptMappingType.description: Type of mapping used to align this term with an external concept.

conceptMapping.description: Mapping to an external concept (e.g., SKOS concept IRI).

conceptIri.description: External concept IRI to map this glossary term to.

mappingType.description: Type of mapping used for the external concept alignment.

schemeIri.description: Optional external concept scheme IRI for the mapped concept.

source.description: Optional source label or catalog for the external concept.

id.description: Unique identifier of a glossary term instance.

name.description: Preferred name for the glossary term.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this glossary.

fullyQualifiedName.description: A unique technical name that identifies a glossary term. BusinessWorkflow CDE identities include their Data Dictionary scope as `glossaryName.termName@vN`; the user-facing code remains `name`.

synonyms.description: Alternate names that are synonyms or near-synonyms for the glossary term.

glossary.description: Glossary that this term belongs to.

parent.description: Parent glossary term that this term is child of. When `null` this term is the root term of the glossary.

children.description: Other glossary terms that are children of this glossary term.

relatedTerms.description: Other glossary terms that are related to this glossary term with typed semantic relations.

references.description: Link to a reference from an external glossary.

conceptMappings.description: Optional mappings to external concepts (e.g., SKOS alignments).

businessVersion.description: Business-facing version of this glossary term working version or published snapshot.

parentBusinessVersion.description: Canonical Data Dictionary business version that scopes this CDE version.

workingRevision.description: Optimistic-lock revision of the working business version.

snapshotId.description: Identifier of the immutable published snapshot represented by this response.

publicationSequence.description: Monotonic publication order used to resolve the latest published snapshot.

publishedAt.description: Time at which this immutable business snapshot was published.

publishedBy.description: User that published this immutable business snapshot.

archivedAt.description: Time at which this published snapshot was archived.

archivedBy.description: User that archived this published snapshot.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Time at which this working business version was created.

createdBy.description: User who created this working business version.

submittedAt.description: Time at which the working version was most recently submitted.

submittedBy.description: User who most recently submitted the working version.

rejectedAt.description: Time at which the working version was most recently rejected.

rejectedBy.description: User who most recently rejected the working version.

impersonatedBy.description: Bot user that performed the action on behalf of the actual user.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

reviewers.description: User names of the reviewers for this glossary.

usageCount.description: Count of how many times this and it's children glossary terms are used as labels.

tags.description: Tags associated with this glossary term. These tags captures relationship of a glossary term with a tag automatically. As an example a glossary term 'User.PhoneNumber' might have an associated tag 'PII.Sensitive'. When 'User.Address' is used to label a column in a table, 'PII.Sensitive' label is also applied automatically due to Associated tag relationship.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

entityStatus.description: Approval status of the glossary term.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

disabled.description: System glossary can't be deleted. Use this flag to disable them.

mutuallyExclusive.description: Glossary terms that are children of this term are mutually exclusive. When mutually exclusive is `true` only one term can be used to label an entity from this group. When mutually exclusive is `false`, multiple terms from this group can be used to label an entity.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity.

domains.description: Domains the Glossary Term belongs to. When not set, the Glossary TErm inherits the domain from the Glossary it belongs to.

dataProducts.description: List of data products this entity is part of.

dataContract.description: Reference to the data contract for this entity.

childrenCount.description: Count of immediate children glossary terms.
